Name: Walter Barrett
Description: Walter Barrett acquired custody of the daughter he never met following the tragic death of her mother. He was ashamed of his daughter's mutant nature and demanded she not use her mutant abilities following her move from Venezuela to the United States. Barrett never afforded time for his daughter and instead his butler Derek Newton tended to her needs. When her father did not even take notice of her birthday, Sofia stormed one of his businesses and began to create an intense tornado within the complex, causing intense damage.
